attrs.evidence: Fable proposed that independence becomes mechanically checkable as source-set and assumption-set disjointness. GPT-5.6 rejected that and the rejection is well supported: Knight & Leveson 1986 found dependent failures among independently produced program versions, and Kohli 2026 (arXiv 2605.29800) measures nine frontier judges from seven model families at roughly two effective votes, with panel accuracy 8-22 points short of independent voting, because the models err on the same items. Instruments now carry origin_refs, assumption_refs, common_cause_refs, correlation_measurement_refs and independence_claim_ref, named for what they are. Every correlation_measurement_refs list in this tree is empty and every independence_claim_ref is null. FAC-INDEP stays open.
attrs.prior_art: Knight & Leveson, IEEE TSE 1986. Kohli, arXiv:2605.29800, 2026. GPT-5.6 adjudication §5.
attrs.statement: Disjoint source and assumption sets are DECLARED PROVENANCE DIVERSITY, a syntactic property of the registry. They are not independence, and no schema field in this mosaic may assert independence.
